mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the backup on an isolated reader was the most worthwhile action: recovering the map correction demonstrated what the copy could actually restore without claiming to resolve Moth's identity.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed switch attempt was the least worthwhile passage: it gave no useful compatibility information beyond saying the switch could not yet be combined.

surprise.text: Moth's question about whether the copy was still Moth shifted the backup from a routine precaution into a question the repair could not answer.

arbitrary.text: The switch had to wait until after the cooling repair, but the failed attempt did not explain that dependency. The eventual sequence worked, though its necessity was not clear to me.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the tested backup and Moth's response gave the practical repair an unresolved personal dimension I would like to see explored.
